description: View the submission artifact as a tiny domain-specific language with only two commands: emit a verified adjacency string or reject unsupported input. This strips away any temptation to smuggle search policy into the solver interface.
mathematical_formalization: API(n) := VerifiedWitness(n) | Unsupported(n); no latent search state enters the denotation.
analogical_connections: total functions with an error monad
instrument controllers with guarded operating modes
implementation_hypothesis: Keep solver logic declarative and push exploration into separate scripts or archived tools.
experiment_seed: AST-audit the root solver and fail if new imports or side-effectful execution paths appear.
